business_summary: Mansei Corporation provides electronic products in Japan. The company offers power control equipment, such as AC servos and inverters; control equipment, including sequencers; power distribution equipment comprising breakers and transformers; and rotary equipment which includes motors, industrial fans, etc. It also provides industrial robots, wire cutting machinery, NC discharge processing machinery, laser processing machinery, and CNC equipment. In addition, the company offers design through installation and follow-up servicing of equipment; semiconductors and device products; system and software development; and electronic product contract manufacturing service, as well as multimedia and information technology services. Mansei Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
